title: Assisted application
intro: CandidatAI opens the job in its own browser, fills in the application form and stops before sending. Nothing is sent without your confirmation. Sign in to your job boards with “Open browser”.
workerHint: The worker hasn't picked it up yet. Is it running? Start it with `uv run cai worker` in backend/.

busy.filling: Filling in the {{domain}} form in the browser…

submit.title: Send the application to {{company}}
submit.description: <button/> will be clicked on <domain/>. This confirmation is only valid for this submission.
submit.typeCompany: Type the company name to confirm

review.missing_one: {{count}} required field is missing: complete it in the browser and click “Review again”, or finish it yourself.
review.missing_other: {{count}} required fields are missing: complete them in the browser and click “Review again”, or finish it yourself.
review.checkFirst: Before marking it as sent, check on the website or in your email that it arrived.

prepare.linkedin: LinkedIn isn't automated: the job will open in CandidatAI's browser and you copy the package from above.
prepare.fill: {{domain}} will open in CandidatAI's browser and the form will be filled in. Nothing is sent until you confirm.

portal.intro: {{portal}} is a job board and blocks automated browsers, so the job opens in your browser, with your session.
portal.step2: If it takes you to the company's form, copy that page's address and paste it below: CandidatAI fills it in its browser and stops before sending.
portal.step3: If the application is completed inside {{portal}}, finish it there (the CV is in “Application package”) and click “Mark as sent”.

done.sent: Sent to {{domain}}: the website confirmed it.

openBrowser.title: Opens CandidatAI's browser so you can sign in to your job boards. It has its own profile, separate from your Chrome.
openBrowser.label: Open browser
